I see a long EW green exceeding max Green — checking intermediate states to confirm the pattern.

EW green persists past its maximum, suggesting max-green enforcement broke. I'll gather timeline evidence before testing a fix.
I've mapped a prolonged EW green starving the NS approaches; now I'll confirm the violation details before testing a fix.
EW green appears to exceed its max-green limit while NS waits. I'll inspect the steps around when it should have terminated.

Ledger: open H1 — detector_fail on W breaks max-green/recall enforcement, letting EW green run ~196s (571→767) past max_green 47 and starving NS past 200s; ruled out none yet. Intervention next: same scenario minus the detector_fail event should restore rotation and pass.
Counterfactual without detector failure passes — confirming causality. Gathering final evidence for the report.
